locationHelp: Move this record to another lab book. Its saved revisions, research links and original evidence stay available. The moved record becomes private; choose its publication availability afterward.
locationIncomplete: The move response was incomplete. Retry this move to check its result.
locationPending: Closing this window does not cancel an admitted move. Reopen Move record and retry to check the same operation.
locationRefreshFailed: The record was moved, but the view could not refresh. Click the Observanda logo to reload saved changes.
addMediaHelp: The original is retained privately. Its prepared copy is attached to this record when processing finishes. Edit its details to choose what may be published.
mediaLibraryHelp: Originals stay private. Use media attaches a prepared copy to this record immediately; the same file can also be attached to other records.
confirmRemoveMedia: Remove "{label}" from this record? The original file, earlier revisions and other records using it will remain available.
mediaPending: The media change has not been confirmed. Retry to check and finish the same change.
mediaDestinationChanged: The destination record changed. Open Media imports in the intended record to attach the prepared file.
editingHelp: Choose a field or section to edit. Save changes in its editor.
confirmRemove: Remove "{title}" from this record? Earlier saved revisions will retain its writing.
sectionPending: The section change has not been confirmed. Retry to check and finish the same change.
failed: The record could not be opened. Try again.
cancelled: Loading stopped. You can try again or choose another section.
enterHeading: Enter a section heading to find.
resultsForFigure: Results for the selected figure or panel
